items.text: The agent at the gate desk sorted my rebooking in minutes. Best service I've had all year.

Just letting you know we arrived and the keys were in the lockbox as described.
Room 812 was spotless and the front desk remembered our anniversary. Lovely stay.
The hotel charged me again at check-in even though I paid in full upfront.

Please note my new address for future invoices: 14 Ashgrove Lane.
Flight was delayed but the crew kept us informed the whole time. Really well handled.
My flight was cancelled and the only rebooking offered was two days later.

No action needed — I found the confirmation in my spam folder.

Baggage arrived with the same flight for once. Whatever changed, keep it.

Confirming I received the updated itinerary and have added it to my calendar.
